title: Airmid Éireann: Ireland's Open Pharma Data Project
description:
Collectors and release builder for Airmid Éireann, an open-data project by Priya Life Science. It gathers public records on medicines, clinical trials, approvals, shortages and the pharmaceutical industry from official sources (HPRA, EMA, U.S. FDA, CSO, ClinicalTrials.gov, Health Canada, NIH) and publishes them as CSV and JSON with source licences, a data dictionary and checksums.

The data itself is published at priyalifescience.com/opendata/airmid/v1. Each dataset keeps the licence of its source. Not medical advice.
